products.name: Expedition Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists no booster box for this set, so it is priced at 36 packs. The real box also held one of four e-Card box toppers, which are not simulated.

products.name: Scan-Tastic Spectacular Promo Pack [Ho-oh & Rapidash]
products.note: Nintendo Power's e-Reader product (2002): the Rapidash and Ho-oh Wizards Black Star Promos, each with e-Reader dot codes for the Fire Hoops mini-game. No booster packs. TCGplayer listing (group 1418).
